career_ladder.note: Junior Assistants and Junior Accountants recruited through TSPSC Group-IV Services are inducted into the Telangana Ministerial Service across various state government departments (Revenue, Commercial Taxes, Treasuries & Accounts, Secretariat, Municipal Administration, and Directorates). Promotions are governed by the Telangana Ministerial Service Rules (TMSR) and respective departmental special rules.

exam_scheme.note: TSPSC Group-IV Services recruitment consists of a single-stage objective type written examination (CBRT / OMR-based) followed by Certificate Verification. There is no oral test (interview) pursuant to G.O.Ms.No.55, General Administration (Ser.A) Department, dated 25/04/2022. The written examination comprises two objective papers of 150 marks each, totalling 300 marks. Minimum qualifying marks are: OC, Sports, Ex-Servicemen & EWS: 40% (120 marks); BCs: 35% (105 marks); SCs, STs & PH: 30% (90 marks).

stages.source_label: TGPSC Group-IV Notification No. 19/2022 Annexure-III (Scheme and Syllabus) & G.O.Ms.No.136 GA (Ser.A) Dept Dt.23/11/2022

papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer across 150 objective multiple-choice questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; evaluated together with Paper-II for aggregate cutoff out of 300 marks; minimum qualifying aggregate is 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/PH

papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer across 150 objective questions covering Mental Ability, Logical Reasoning, Comprehension, Sentence Re-arrangement, and Numerical/Arithmetical Abilities)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; evaluated together with Paper-I for aggregate cutoff out of 300 marks; minimum qualifying aggregate is 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/PH

stages.source_label: TGPSC Group-IV Notification No. 19/2022 Certificate Verification Notification & Schedule Dt.16/06/2024

papers.paper_name: Verification of Original Certificates & Web-Options Allotment
papers.qualifying_threshold: Candidates shortlisted in 1:3 ratio based on merit in the 300-mark written examination must submit original qualification, community, residence, non-creamy layer, and medical certificates; allotment to zones/departments made strictly by merit and web options

financial_package.note: Junior Assistants, Junior Accountants, and Junior Auditors recruited through TSPSC Group-IV Services are appointed under the Telangana Revised Pay Scales 2020 (RPS 2020), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.51, Finance (HRM.IV) Department, dated 11/06/2021. The posts are placed in Scale 6 (₹24,280 – 72,850) with an Entry Basic Pay of ₹24,280. State Dearness Allowance (DA) is pegged at the project review benchmark of 58%. House Rent Allowance (HRA) is governed by G.O.Ms.No.53, Finance Department (24% for Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation area, 13% for district headquarters/major towns, and 11% for other locations).
financial_package.pay_source_label: TGPSC Group-IV Notification No. 19/2022 Para I(2) & G.O.Ms.No.51 Finance (HRM.IV) Dept Dt.11/06/2021
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on entry basic pay of ₹24,280 with 58% DA (₹14,082), HRA ranging from 11% (₹2,671 in rural/other postings) to 24% (₹5,827 in GHMC Hyderabad), plus fixed medical allowance and city compensatory allowance. In-hand reflects standard deductions: 10% NPS employee contribution on Basic+DA (₹3,836), Professional Tax (₹200), and TSGLI/GIS/EHS contributions (~₹600–₹800).
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) indexed to AICPI as per Telangana state government orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 11%, 13%, or 24% of basic pay based on posting station
Employee Health Scheme (EHS) providing cashless hospitalisation for employees and dependents
Telangana State Government Life Insurance (TSGLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) coverage
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with matching 14% government contribution
Earned leave, surrender leave encashment, casual leave, and festive advance as per state service rules
